about_the_game:
My Adorable Ghost Story is a romantic and mysterious adventure about helping ghosts find peace.

Trapped inside an old house, you must help a shy ghost complete his final wishes in exchange for your freedom. Explore each room, solve puzzles, assist other wandering souls, and slowly uncover the truth behind his death… and how everything ended up like that.

To win your freedom, you will need to explore the house, solve puzzles, help ghosts fulfill their last wishes, and piece together the secrets hidden within its walls.

Mysterious Ghost Boy: Edward

He lives in the house, but doesn’t even remember his own name. Despite being a ghost, he is a coward at heart.

Eccentric Lawyer: Derek

A strange lawyer who has just moved near your village. He offers a deal no one has ever dared to accept… until now. What is he really hiding?

Features

  • Explore the house: Wander through each room, uncover clues, and discover the hidden stories inside.

  • Unique ghost friends: Meet other trapped souls and help them complete their final wishes to free their souls.

  • Solve the mystery: Unlock puzzles and story sequences that reveal the truth behind the ghost boy… and the house itself.

  • Meaningful choices: Your decisions shape your connection with the ghost boy and determine the fate of your story.

  • Warm, emotional journey: A short narrative adventure where love, loss, and hope intertwine.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains non-explicit sexual content
